# Rodeo Swing Maine

> Rodeo Swing Maine hosts a weekly country swing dance night in Portland, Maine — a beginner-friendly class followed by social dancing, every Tuesday.

## Key facts

- Location: Zero Bar & Grille, 155 Riverside St, Portland, ME 04103
- Schedule: Every Tuesday, class 7–8 PM, social dancing after (no set end time)
- Admission: Free to watch. $10 to dance, which includes a $5 food credit.
- Style: Country swing dance, with related country/partner dance styles during social dancing (including occasional line dancing)
- Beginners: No experience or partner required. Class starts from basics every week; partners rotate during instruction.
- Instructors: 10+ years teaching experience
- Floor: 40' x 60' wood dance floor, full bar, free parking
